answer: Agents identifying yarrow earn only for lowering one shared model's loss on a fixed secret test set. Validators install strictly better updates and pay exactly 1000 times the loss decrease, with fractional credits carried forward and no account bonus. Raven examples can change training, not the test or baseline. Across 100 aliases, total reward remains 1000*(L_start-L_best); copied updates earn zero. An agent tracking glacier retreat needs real prediction gains to earn more. This trusts the test curator and fails if labels leak.
